title: DMC-5: Dual-Model Collaboration with Cache-aware Context Compression for Long-horizon Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.30412v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon agents repeatedly feed an ever-growing interaction trajectory to a specialized agent model. Prefix caching reuses computation over repeated history, but cannot prevent context growth or remove information irrelevant to the current decision. This is especially costly when the specialized agent lacks the cached-input discounts available to general-purpose models, making trajectory compression a natural alternative. However, existing compression methods on selective context risk losing global information, recursively rewriting summary leads to semantic drift, while repeatedly recompressing the full history shifts the growing cost to the compressor. Therefore, we introduce DMC-5 (Dual-Model Collaboration with CaChe-aware Context Compression), an asymmetric framework that assigns full-history integration to a general compression model and action generation to a specialized agent model. DMC-5 maintains the raw trajectory as an App

translated_title: DMC-5：面向长程智能体的缓存感知上下文压缩双模型协作框架
translated_abstract: 长程智能体反复地将不断增长的交互轨迹输入给专门的智能体模型。前缀缓存可以复用对重复历史的计算，但既无法阻止上下文的增长，也无法剔除与当前决策无关的信息。当专门智能体不具备通用模型所享有的缓存输入折扣时，这一问题尤其代价高昂，这使得轨迹压缩成为一种自然的替代方案。然而，现有的选择性上下文压缩方法存在丢失全局信息的风险，递归式地重写摘要会导致语义漂移，而反复重新压缩完整历史则会将不断增长的成本转移给压缩器。因此，我们提出了DMC-5（基于缓存感知上下文压缩的双模型协作），这是一个非对称框架：将完整历史的整合工作分配给通用压缩模型，将动作生成工作分配给专门的智能体模型。DMC-5将原始轨迹保持为一个App……
tldr: DMC-5提出了一种非对称双模型协作框架，由通用压缩模型负责缓存感知的完整历史整合，由专门智能体模型负责动作生成，从而解决了长程智能体中上下文持续增长以及现有压缩方法丢失全局信息、语义漂移和重复压缩成本高的问题。
en_tdlr: DMC-5 introduces an asymmetric dual-model collaboration framework in which a general compression model handles cache-aware full-history integration while a specialized agent model generates actions, addressing context growth and the limitations of existing compression methods (global information loss, semantic drift, and recompression costs) for long-horizon agents.
